question: In relation to the treatment of a non-smoking woman with non-small cell lung carcinoma, stage IV adenocarcinoma, which of the following statements is correct?

options.opa: The determination of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutation is required.
options.opb: Entry Gefitinib is the standard treatment without EGFR determination.
options.opc: It has a standard treatment based on camptothecins.
options.opd: Any type of standard chemotherapy is valid.
options.ope: There is no predictive factor for this disease.
